d: West Indies have pushed India to a T20I series decider, producing some outstanding performances against the reigning T20 World Cup champions. But behind the team's fight on the field lies a financial crisis at Cricket West Indies, with players facing 25% pay cuts and the board struggling with revenue, rising costs and the future of Caribbean cricket. Why is a team capable of challenging India struggling to sustain its own cricketing system? Rupha Ramani breaks down the crisis behind West Indies cricket.
